name: Sakurai Minaho
source:
First year student.
Sharp-minded and disciplined, a holier than thou but serious young lady who gives off an aloof and tsundere-like vibe.
Hates crooked things and mistakes, and always tries to be fair following her strong sense of responsibility.
She wants to study Law and be helpful to many people.
